name: Cyber Alsafi
desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must first be Special Summoned (from your hand) while you control a Machine "Cyber" monster. If this card is Special Summoned: You can add 1 "Born from Draconis" from your Deck to your hand. If this card is banished: You can activate this effect; until the end of your turn, the next battle damage your Level 10 LIGHT Machine monster inflicts to your opponent is doubled. You can only use each effect of "Cyber Alsafi" once per turn.
